review.reason: 리뷰 거절: server/internal/figures/figures.go:73 `case character == ',' || unicode.IsSpace(character)` no longer ends the figure at a space, so a value holding several numbers glues them together. The documented line-chart row form (docs/deck-source.md:91 `- 전환 전 | 120, 118, 121, 119`) is parsed by parseSourceItem -> figures.Of into 1.20118121119e+11 instead of 120. Verified by running the same probe on both trees: main gives Number=120 for that row, HEAD gives Number=1.20118121119e+11. / server/internal/deck/source.go:700 the regression above escapes to user-visible output. compile.go leaves Items on a ::line block (only ::table clears them, compile.go:143), pptx.SanitizeBlock keeps them, and inspect.go:752 includes BlockLine in plottedFigures. statesFigure("120, 118, 121, 119") is false, so the audit emits the finding `figures with no source: 전환 전 120118121119` (verified by direct call to plottedFigures).
